values.meaning: maximum Mortal Will stacks needed to empower next ability

mechanics.claim: Pantheon generates a stack of Mortal Will whenever he lands a basic attack on-hit or casts an ability, up to 5 stacks.
mechanics.quote: generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Mortal Will'' whenever he lands a {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} or casts an {{tip|ability}}, stacking up to 5 times

mechanics.claim: At 5 stacks, Pantheon's next basic ability consumes the stacks to become empowered with an additional effect.
mechanics.quote: At 5 stacks, '''Pantheon's''' next basic ability consumes the stacks to become empowered with an additional effect.

mechanics.claim: Pantheon gains maximum stacks upon starting the game, completing a Recall channel, and respawning.
mechanics.quote: '''Pantheon''' gains maximum stacks of ''Mortal Will'' upon starting the game, completing a {{si|Recall}} channel, and [[death|respawning]].
